issues: The stop rule (Section 6) was violated: the initial probability of 0.03 is well below the 0.15 threshold and supported by multiple independent pieces of evidence (the transaction model score of 0.005 and a history of 10 card-present transactions in the same billing region). The investigation should have stopped immediately without contacting the customer or opening a case.
R1 was misapplied: R1 only requires verification before blocking a card on a weak signal. Since no block was indicated or necessary, VERIFY_WITH_CUSTOMER was not required under R1.
events.what_would_change_verdict: If the transaction model score had been high or if there were no historical transactions in billing region 444, raising the probability above 0.15, then opening a case and verifying with the customer would be required.
